It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival of the Best” now on Steam! I hope you enjoy it and I am looking forward to everyone’s feedback!

I have been so busy with feedback and bug fixing on the Steam build for the coming days, so there will be a short hiatus for the blog for a while. Catch me up at @tassygames on twitter/mastodon

You can still watch me develop the game to become the final product live from time to time, if you are interested. You can still catch me Mondays and Thursdays doing livestreams and preparing with Twitch. The stream links are twitch/twitter/mastodon, or my Discord. (My next twitch is on January 13th.)

You can also play the old version of the game! Which is still on It's Website (https://tassygames.com), the Steam version is $4 now.<eos>Later on this year, I will try to release the game in mobile stores, I hope. I don't expect many phone players, but this part I don't know. New games are not super popular on some mobiles unfortunately.

I wish you good holidays!<eos>-Tassy<eos>-<eos>Since the official release I have been busy on Steam. I currently don’t think it was a good idea to making the game into 2 playable parts, but it became that way very fast. Now I am in work with the bug-fixing at this stage.

So at this moment there are 15 bugs in the Steam build that I aim on to fix. 5 are big and 10 are not big, I have a list of all things (and some little things I have not put on the list yet) you will not experience on the Steam build. It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival” right now, without waiting a few more months for the release on Steam!

I just got a Steam badge. That’s a start! Here’s a photo of my game and me.

Now the next step is to get it reviewed. For that, I need people to try it. If you do that, I would be really grateful!

Now is the best time to try the game. If it takes your interest, you have some time left to write your evaluation. Later, if you do not buy it, you can still inform what you thought about it, but that will be rare…<eos>

The game is on Steam “wishlist”. If you don’t know what to do with your free time at all and are looking for some fun on your couch or on the go on your mobile device, put it on your wishlist!

As a member of the Steam tester’s program, you can easily share it with your friends and on social networks with a corresponding link.

To enable yourself play and read some more words about the game, I leave you this link again (en): https://store.steamgame.com/app/1063320/Polygon_Survival

(ru/en): https://store.steamgame.com/app/1283690/Polygon_Survival___Survival__pre_release/

The game is worth about 200-660 ofrub. I was not able to find an official price yet. For free, but. price, this level depends on many things:

* how many covers will be bought in a window;
* player ratings and reviews (without it, the game will not be promoted higher and many more potential buyers don’t see it);
* bugs too;

I have done work for many months. I wish it was normal when you “press a button in the store” and the game is fully ready

It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival of the Dead” while browsing through this post. The time until the next patch is December 17th, with around 6 weeks until Pathfinder: Kingmaker will be released on PC. I’ll be doing a bunch of writing related to Kingmaker, especially on Backer Report and all the posts to follow this one. I’ll try to post as regularly as I can, but with so much happening for the game across so many platforms, and still lots more going on from here to December 17, I might not be able to keep up with my posts! So, without any more rambling, here’s some stuff about “Survival of the Dead”: * D&D character creation was done in the game. * 135 minutes of play, with a diverse selection of characters. * There were no 1hr campaigns. * The new Legendary and Divine paths were explored, as with the classic game Adventurer’s Guide. * There were 22 legendary characters, and 5 divine characters. * This includes the prestige classes at level 4 and 8. * There were 5 paladin turns. * There were 15 fighters. * The Forgotten Soldier gets to start with 4 different skills, and becomes completely jack-of-all-trades in just 2 more levels. * The Holy Champion, including the new prestige feature, is one of the Fighter’s broader all-purpose options. * There were 10 clerics, and 3 druids. * There were 10 sorcerers (5 wizards and 5 witches) * The druid prestige features were played in every single game I did. * druid foci * not a thing in the edition we play. Don’t know how much I’ll feel like writing about it during Kingmaker

It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival of the Dead.” It was a fun experience at the end because I could play the game without worrying about bugs, because I had already submitted the game for bugs. I had read the rules that a games developer should submit their game by Friday 6PM Eastern time. I just realized we have the same time. It is 6:06 right now. Anyway, this was the last demo of Survival of the Dead. I will think of what I can do next with my time now. I really had fun working on it. I can’t wait to see what kind of game you make with it in the future. Thank you so much for playing this short web game, and I hope you had fun. “Survival of the Dead” won’t be submitting anymore. His last entry is here.He has no more info to give if you encounter any problems.He wants to learn about making a game properly now. You can email your feedback to his business email address: jimi_m@hotmail.com if you want.He would be very happy to hear from you about any bugs or things that can be helped for the future of his survival game. Thank you for your efforts to make his life better in the short time he has it free again. Go well, save your thoughts on the next game that you want to make. See you next time if you like it, and he will be happy to tell you. You can tell that he is a decent person and he will be better with you once he has enough time to spare for your company. “Survival of the Dead” will be leaving you soon and it is sad for him when the time comes. However, I am happy that the game is nice. I am even more happy for him because I don’t have to code bugs with him. They would be nice because what
